name: Input Overlay
author: Codex
description: Shows recent key presses and mouse clicks in a movable overlay. While enabled, it listens globally and displays key names locally; input is not stored or sent anywhere.

settings.label: Show keyboard presses
settings.hint: Listens for key presses while this addon is on.

settings.label: Show mouse inputs
settings.hint: Listens for button presses and scroll wheel input.

settings.label: Hide when no input is held
settings.hint: Hide the overlay when no keyboard key or mouse button is held down.

settings.label: Hide idle prompt
settings.hint: Hide the “Press a key or click to show input here” box when there are no recent inputs.

settings.label: Show HUD frame
settings.hint: Show Nyerk's outer background and border around this addon overlay.
